_comment: Data-driven provider identity (W3-A / T2). Replaces hardcoded keyword/domain matches in routers/llm.py so a new provider is added here, not in code. 'key' indexes docs/development/llm_provider_notes/<key>.md for notable models. An endpoint matches by a keyword in its id/display-name (lowercased) OR by its host's registrable domain (host == domain or host endswith .domain). 'display_alias' is the human name for the provider.
